intro: One glass of Nescafe tarik is about 160 kcal. Most of the calories come from the generous amount of condensed milk.
diet: Yes, as long as it's not every time you lepak. One glass has about the same calories as a slice of buttered toast. The problem is when you drink 2-3 glasses a day without noticing. Kurang manis or O kosong helps a lot.
tips: Ask for 'kurang manis' or 'satu sudu susu je'.
Choose a regular glass, not the large size or a jug.
If you want coffee in the morning and afternoon, make one of them O kosong.

swap.name: Nescafe O kosong with a little fresh milk
swap.why: Still creamy, but with much less sugar.

faq.q: What's the difference between Nescafe tarik and kopi tarik?
faq.a: Nescafe tarik uses instant coffee. Kopi tarik uses brewed coffee from local coffee powder.
Pulling mixes the milk in well and creates foam. It gives a smoother texture.

faq.q: Does it have a lot of caffeine?
faq.a: One glass is usually moderate. If you're sensitive, avoid drinking it late in the afternoon.
